project.title: O-linked and N-linked analysis of PTP69D (Drosophila melanogaster)
project.projectDescription: Identifying N-linked and O-linked sites of glycosylation on PTP69D (Drosophila melanogaster) by sHCD and CID neutral loss-trigged MS3.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Protein samples were digested with trypsin and deglycosylated with PNGase A/F combination. Resulting peptides were cleaning up over C18 spin columns, concentrated via speed vacuum, resuspended, and injected into an Orbitrap Eclipse utilizing two different instrument methods.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: Raw data was searched with Byonic (4.1.10) and Proteome Discoverer (2.5.0.400.

references.referenceLine: Monagas-Valentin P, Bridger R, Chandel I, Koff M, Novikov B, Schroeder P, Wells L, Panin V. Protein tyrosine phosphatase 69D is a substrate of protein O-mannosyltransferases 1-2 that is required for the wiring of sensory axons in Drosophila. J Biol Chem. 2023 299(3):102890
